input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_invoice_fields.py
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    system_prompt = (
+        "Extract invoice fields as strict JSON with keys vendor, date, total, and line_items. "
+        "Each line item should include description, quantity, unit_price, and amount when present. "
+        "Return only JSON."
+    )
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
+            {"role": "user", "content": invoice_text},
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    content = response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    return json.loads(content)
*** End Patch
